The '''wampa cave''' in the [[Lanteel Glacier]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] was where [[Luke Skywalker]] was brought after being attacked by a [[Unidentified wampa|male wampa]]. The Jedi-in-training later escaped, defendeding himself from a [[One-Arm|female wampa's]] advances by slicing off her arm.

==Behind the scenes==
The wampa cave first appeared in the [[1980]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]] film {{Film|V}}.<ref name="ESB" /> It was later identified in the a [[Trading card game (disambiguation)|card]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]], for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars Trading Card Game]] [[The Empire Strikes Back (TCG)|expansion]] of the same name.<ref name="card">{{TCG|set=The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=Wampa Cave|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/ESB/Wampa_Cave.webp?v=2}}</ref>
